newsitem.title: USA: GM says 22,913 employees still idled.
newsitem.headline: GM says 22,913 employees still idled.

text.p: General Motors Corp said on Tuesday that 22,913 North American employees were still idled as of 1100 EST as a result of a strike by the Canadian Auto Workers Union that ended last week.
Today's employee number does not include Delphi where the majority of employees have returned to work. Delphi is no longer issuing daily reports.
There has been no change in the status of GM vehicle assembly operations today. However, the total number of employees affected increased by 174, it said.
GM repeated that it will not speculate on when workers in the U.S. will return to their operations.
Starting today, updates on GM operations will be issued once a day at 1100 EST.
Members of the CAW ratified a tentative labor contract last Tuesday and are returning to work in stages.
